description_en: Call ListAgentStates to obtain agent states
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-agent-states --instance-id 9cfad875-6260-4a53-ab6e-b13e3fb31f7d --skill-group-id XXX --agent-ids 237432034227828673 --state ACW --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2017-07-05 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAgentStates

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the call center
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of agent IDs.

An agent ID is the same as the RAM sub-account ID of the agent. A maximum of 50 agents can be specified. If this parameter is not specified, all agents are queried
parameters.help_zh:
坐席ID列表。

坐席ID等同于该座席的RAM子账户ID，最多50个坐席；不传则查询全部
parameters.name: agent_ids

parameters.help_en:
The list of agent states.

If this parameter is not specified, all states are queried. Valid values: ACW: after-call work, Break: on break, Dialing: dialing, Ringing: ringing, Ready: ready, Talking: on a call
parameters.help_zh:
坐席状态列表。

不传查询全部。枚举值：ACW:话后处理中,Break:小休,Dialing:拨号,Ringing:振铃,Ready:等待,Talking:通话
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en: The page size. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，默认值为10，最大是100
parameters.name: page_size
